title.narrative: Support to Peru¿s electoral process as a crisis and conflict prevention measure

description.narrative:
Peru has been going through a long-standing political crisis since 2016. Corruption scandals and continued disputes between the executive and legislative branches of government have led to a high turnover in presidents ¿ five since 2016. While the 2021 general elections were overall credible and conducted with integrity, they were not able to offset this worsening political context. In a context of economic uncertainty and general and growing mistrust of the population in their democratic institutions and elected officials, there is an increasing risk of instability. The present situation makes it necessary to adopt an exceptional assistance measure regarding Peru.

The objective of the measure set out in this Decision is to promote transparent, trustworthy and peaceful electoral processes and the promotion of democratic solutions to electoral and political conflicts in order to remedy exceptional and unforeseen situations. The activities set out in this Decision will strengthen electoral institutions and subnational authorities and the capacities of political and civil society organisations to prevent and manage political and electoral conflicts.
